messages:
liz: Heads-up — SIEM is reporting a big spike in KMS decrypt_error alerts starting ~12:10 UTC, ~3.2k hits in the last hour. Mostly from deployment service accounts. Anyone digging in?

jon: saw pager. 12:10–12:25 window. looks correlated to a deploy window. suspect RBAC/key rotation flurry :thinking: 

maria: looking at audit logs now — we rotated a deploy service account key at 12:05 and some runners didn't pick up creds. logs show repeated failures: 

maria: ```
2026-03-20T12:12:34Z svc=runner-orf id=svc-deploy-3 error=AccessDeniedException message="not authorized to decrypt" resource=kms:decrypt key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abc123
```

raj: OK if that's true the rule is too noisy for transient rotation events. current rule is basically: 

raj: ```
index=cloud-logs sourcetype=kms "AccessDeniedException" | stats count by service_account
```

raj: we should add velocity threshold + suppression window and whitelist infra runners.

alex: agree. quick tweak suggestion: 

alex: ```
index=cloud-logs sourcetype=kms "AccessDeniedException"
| where service_account !in ("svc-deploy-main", "infra-runner")
| timechart span=5m count by service_account
| where count > 50
```

liz: Also want to tag known rotation events from audit logs and silence matching decrypt errors for 10m per account. That avoids losing real alerts while cutting noise.

sec-bot: Automated note: created incident IR-2026-045 and attached originating alert cluster.

jon: can we auto-correlate with KMS key-rotation/cloudtrail events? If so suppress for 15m after rotation.

maria: yes — CloudTrail has ScheduleKeyRotation/RotateKey events. proposed correlation pseudo-KQL: 

maria: ```
from logs
where eventName in ("ScheduleKeyRotation","RotateKey","DisableKeyRotation")
| join decrypt_errors by keyId within 15m
| tag "rotation_correlated"
```

liz: implemented temporary suppression in the SIEM for rule id=3421: suppression active for accounts that match rotation tag, window=12m. monitoring FP rate.

raj: updated dashboards: added service_account + env breakdown and anomaly baseline. dashboard link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/kms-decrypts 

alex: post-incident actions we should capture: 
1) add infra-runner service account whitelist
2) add rotation correlation rule (maria owner)
3) implement auto-suppress for rotation_correlated decrypts for 15m (liz owner)
4) update runbook to verify SA propagation on rotation (jon owner)
5) tune threshold to 50/5m for non-whitelisted accounts

liz: I'll draft the postmortem blurb and recommend default auto-suppress for decrypt failures that correlate to key rotation events.

maria: FYI: runners fixed at 12:20 after manual propagate, counts back to baseline by 12:30. no further escalation.

jon: :thumbsup: good catch. please annotate future alerts with last rotation event id so we can see correlation at-a-glance.

sec-bot: Incident IR-2026-045 status: resolved. Closed by liz at 1971234620.
